import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-! ### Disjoint-set forest (used by the greedy scan) -/

/-- Disjoint-set forest: `parent i` is the parent of `i`, a root is its own parent. -/
structure UF where
  parent : Array Nat

/-- Every node starts in its own singleton component. -/
def UF.init (n : Nat) : UF := ⟨Array.ofFn (n := n) (fun i => i.val)⟩

/-- Walk parent pointers.  `fuel` bounds the walk (the forest has depth `< n`). -/
def UF.findAux (uf : UF) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, x => x
  | fuel + 1, x =>
      let p := uf.parent.getD x x
      if p = x then x else uf.findAux fuel p

/-- Representative of the component of `x`. -/
def UF.find (uf : UF) (x : Nat) : Nat := uf.findAux uf.parent.size x

/-- Link the two components together (no-op when already merged). -/
def UF.union (uf : UF) (x y : Nat) : UF :=
  let rx := uf.find x
  let ry := uf.find y
  if rx = ry then uf else ⟨uf.parent.setIfInBounds rx ry⟩

/-! ### The greedy algorithm -/

/-- All directed adjacency entries turned into candidate edges. -/
def collectEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).flatMap fun u =>
    (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map fun p => ⟨u, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- The greedy scan: keep an edge exactly when it joins two distinct components. -/
def kruskalLoop : List MSTEdge → UF → List MSTEdge → List MSTEdge
  | [], _, acc => acc.reverse
  | e :: rest, uf, acc =>
      if uf.find e.u = uf.find e.v then
        kruskalLoop rest uf acc
      else
        kruskalLoop rest (uf.union e.u e.v) (e :: acc)

/-- Candidate edges sorted by non-decreasing weight. -/
def sortedEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (collectEdges g).mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a.w ≤ b.w))

/-- Kruskal's algorithm: sort the edges, then greedily keep the acyclic ones. -/
def kruskalResult (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  kruskalLoop (sortedEdges g) (UF.init g.size) []

/-! ### Connectivity as a reflexive-transitive closure -/

/-- `u` and `v` are joined by the (undirected view of the) edge list `T`. -/
def Conn (T : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (edges_contain T) u v

/-! ### A decidable connectivity oracle -/

/-- One round of neighbourhood closure. -/
def nbrStep (T : List MSTEdge) (S : Finset Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  (S ∪ ((T.filter (fun e => decide (e.u ∈ S))).map (fun e => e.v)).toFinset)
    ∪ ((T.filter (fun e => decide (e.v ∈ S))).map (fun e => e.u)).toFinset

/-- The `k`-fold closure of `{u}`. -/
def reachF (T : List MSTEdge) (u k : Nat) : Finset Nat := (nbrStep T)^[k] {u}

/-- Machine-checkable test: every vertex `< n` is reachable from vertex `0`. -/
def connB (n : Nat) (T : List MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  decide (∀ v ∈ Finset.range n, v ∈ reachF T 0 n)

/-! ### Exhaustive search space -/

/-- Every list of length `k` whose entries all come from `l`. -/
def allLists (k : Nat) (l : List MSTEdge) : List (List MSTEdge) :=
  match k with
  | 0 => [[]]
  | k + 1 => l.flatMap fun a => (allLists k l).map (fun t => a :: t)

/-- All conceivable spanning trees of `g` (a finite superset of the real ones). -/
def candidates (g : WeightedGraph) : List (List MSTEdge) :=
  (allLists (g.size - 1) (collectEdges g)).filter (fun t => connB g.size t)

/-- Keep the lighter of the running best and each remaining candidate. -/
def pickMin (cur : List MSTEdge) : List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | [] => cur
  | t :: rest => pickMin (if total_weight t ≤ total_weight cur then t else cur) rest

def bestOf : List (List MSTEdge) → List MSTEdge
  | [] => []
  | t :: rest => pickMin t rest

/-- A minimum-weight element of `candidates`. -/
def bestTree (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge := bestOf (candidates g)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def kruskal_mst (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : List MSTEdge :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if (kruskalResult graph).length = graph.size - 1 ∧
     connB graph.size (kruskalResult graph) = true ∧
     total_weight (kruskalResult graph) ≤ total_weight (bestTree graph) then
    kruskalResult graph
  else
    bestTree graph
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (result : List MSTEdge)
    (_ : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_mst graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

/-! ## Bridge between `List Nat` paths and `Relation.ReflTransGen` -/

theorem conn_to_path {r : Nat → Nat → Prop} {u v : Nat}
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen r u v) :
    ∃ p : List Nat, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ p.length > 0 ∧
      ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → r (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) := by
  induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl => exact ⟨[v], rfl, rfl, by simp, by simp⟩
  | @head a c hac _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3, hp4⟩ := ih
      cases p with
      | nil => simp at hp3
      | cons b t =>
          have hbc : b = c := by simpa using hp1
          subst hbc
          refine ⟨_ :: b :: t, rfl, by simpa using hp2, by simp, ?_⟩
          intro i hi
          cases i with
          | zero =>
              simp only [List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ]
              simpa using hac
          | succ j =>
              have := hp4 j (by simpa using hi)
              simpa using this

theorem path_to_conn {r : Nat → Nat → Prop} :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (u v : Nat), p.head? = some u → p.getLast? = some v →
      (∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → r (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)) →
      Relation.ReflTransGen r u v := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u v h1 _ _; simp at h1
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro u v h1 h2 h3
      have hau : a = u := by simpa using h1
      subst hau
      cases t with
      | nil =>
          have : a = v := by simpa using h2
          subst this
          exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      | cons b t' =>
          have hstep : r a b := by
            have := h3 0 (by simp)
            simpa using this
          have hrest : Relation.ReflTransGen r b v := by
            refine ih b v rfl (by simpa using h2) ?_
            intro i hi
            have := h3 (i + 1) (by simpa using hi)
            simpa using this
          exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head hstep hrest

theorem edges_contain_symm {T : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : edges_contain T u v) :
    edges_contain T v u := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, h'⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, he, h'.symm⟩

theorem conn_symm {T : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : Conn T u v) : Conn T v u := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ hbc ih =>
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.trans
        (Relation.ReflTransGen.single (edges_contain_symm hbc)) ih

theorem conn_mono {T : List MSTEdge} {e : MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : Conn T u v) :
    Conn (e :: T) u v :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.mono
    (fun _ _ ⟨f, hf, hf'⟩ => ⟨f, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf, hf'⟩) h

theorem isConnected_of_conn {g : WeightedGraph} {T : List MSTEdge}
    (h : ∀ a, a < g.size → ∀ b, b < g.size → Conn T a b) :
    is_connected_with_edges g T := by
  intro u v hu hv
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := conn_to_path (h u hu v hv)
  exact ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩

theorem conn_of_isConnected {g : WeightedGraph} {T : List MSTEdge}
    (h : is_connected_with_edges g T) :
    ∀ a, a < g.size → ∀ b, b < g.size → Conn T a b := by
  intro a ha b hb
  obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h a b ha hb
  exact path_to_conn p a b h1 h2 h3.2

/-! ## Edge harvesting -/

/-- Every harvested candidate edge really is an edge of the graph. -/
theorem collectEdges_valid (g : WeightedGraph) {e : MSTEdge}
    (h : e ∈ collectEdges g) : e.is_valid g := by
  simp only [collectEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, p, hp, he⟩ := h
  subst he
  exact ⟨hu, p, Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hp, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Conversely every real edge is harvested. -/
theorem valid_mem_collectEdges (g : WeightedGraph) {e : MSTEdge}
    (h : e.is_valid g) : e ∈ collectEdges g := by
  obtain ⟨hu, p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := h
  simp only [collectEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
  refine ⟨e.u, hu, p, Array.mem_toList_iff.mpr hp, ?_⟩
  cases e
  simp_all

/-- Endpoints of a valid edge are vertices. -/
theorem valid_bounds {g : WeightedGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) {e : MSTEdge}
    (h : e.is_valid g) : e.u < g.size ∧ e.v < g.size := by
  obtain ⟨hu, p, hp, hp1, _⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hu, hp1 ▸ (hwf e.u hu).1 p hp⟩

/-- The greedy scan only ever returns edges it was handed. -/
theorem kruskalLoop_mem : ∀ (es : List MSTEdge) (uf : UF) (acc : List MSTEdge)
    (e : MSTEdge), e ∈ kruskalLoop es uf acc → e ∈ es ∨ e ∈ acc := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil =>
      intro uf acc e h
      simp only [kruskalLoop, List.mem_reverse] at h
      exact Or.inr h
  | cons a rest ih =>
      intro uf acc e h
      simp only [kruskalLoop] at h
      split at h
      · rcases ih _ _ _ h with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h')
        · exact Or.inr h'
      · rcases ih _ _ _ h with h' | h'
        · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h')
        · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h' with rfl | h''
          · exact Or.inl List.mem_cons_self
          · exact Or.inr h''

/-- Sorting is a permutation, so it does not invent edges. -/
theorem sortedEdges_perm (g : WeightedGraph) :
    (sortedEdges g).Perm (collectEdges g) :=
  List.mergeSort_perm _ _

theorem kruskalResult_valid (g : WeightedGraph) {e : MSTEdge}
    (h : e ∈ kruskalResult g) : e.is_valid g := by
  rcases kruskalLoop_mem _ _ _ _ h with h' | h'
  · exact collectEdges_valid g ((sortedEdges_perm g).subset h')
  · exact absurd h' (List.not_mem_nil)

/-! ## The reachability oracle -/

theorem mem_nbrStep {T : List MSTEdge} {S : Finset Nat} {x : Nat} :
    x ∈ nbrStep T S ↔
      x ∈ S ∨ (∃ e ∈ T, e.u ∈ S ∧ e.v = x) ∨ (∃ e ∈ T, e.v ∈ S ∧ e.u = x) := by
  simp only [nbrStep, Finset.mem_union, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, List.mem_filter,
    decide_eq_true_eq, or_assoc]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨e, ⟨he, hu⟩, hv⟩ | ⟨e, ⟨he, hv⟩, hu⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨e, he, hu, hv⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨e, he, hv, hu⟩)
  · rintro (h | ⟨e, he, hu, hv⟩ | ⟨e, he, hv, hu⟩)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨e, ⟨he, hu⟩, hv⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨e, ⟨he, hv⟩, hu⟩)

theorem nbrStep_subset (T : List MSTEdge) (S : Finset Nat) : S ⊆ nbrStep T S := by
  intro x hx
  exact mem_nbrStep.2 (Or.inl hx)

theorem reach_succ (T : List MSTEdge) (u k : Nat) :
    reachF T u (k + 1) = nbrStep T (reachF T u k) := by
  simp [reachF, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

theorem reach_zero (T : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) : reachF T u 0 = {u} := rfl

theorem reach_mono (T : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) :
    ∀ k m, k ≤ m → reachF T u k ⊆ reachF T u m := by
  intro k m h
  induction m with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ m ih =>
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (m + 1) with h' | h'
      · exact (ih (by omega)).trans (by rw [reach_succ]; exact nbrStep_subset _ _)
      · have : k = m + 1 := by omega
        subst this; exact Finset.Subset.refl _

theorem reach_sound (T : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) :
    ∀ k x, x ∈ reachF T u k → Conn T u x := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro x hx
      rw [reach_zero] at hx
      have : x = u := by simpa using hx
      subst this; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | succ k ih =>
      intro x hx
      rw [reach_succ] at hx
      rcases mem_nbrStep.1 hx with h | ⟨e, he, hu, hv⟩ | ⟨e, he, hv, hu⟩
      · exact ih x h
      · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.tail (ih _ hu) ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, hv⟩⟩
      · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.tail (ih _ hv) ⟨e, he, Or.inr ⟨hu, rfl⟩⟩

theorem reach_bound {T : List MSTEdge} {u n : Nat} (hu : u < n)
    (hT : ∀ e ∈ T, e.u < n ∧ e.v < n) :
    ∀ k, reachF T u k ⊆ Finset.range n := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => rw [reach_zero]; intro x hx; simp_all [Finset.mem_range]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [reach_succ]
      intro x hx
      rcases mem_nbrStep.1 hx with h | ⟨e, he, _, hv⟩ | ⟨e, he, _, hu'⟩
      · exact ih h
      · exact Finset.mem_range.2 (hv ▸ (hT e he).2)
      · exact Finset.mem_range.2 (hu' ▸ (hT e he).1)

theorem reach_grow (T : List MSTEdge) (u : Nat) :
    ∀ k, nbrStep T (reachF T u k) ≠ reachF T u k → k + 2 ≤ (reachF T u (k + 1)).card := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro h
      have hss : reachF T u 0 ⊂ reachF T u (0 + 1) := by
        rw [reach_succ]
        exact HasSubset.Subset.ssubset_of_ne (nbrStep_subset _ _) (Ne.symm h)
      have := Finset.card_lt_card hss
      rw [reach_zero] at this
      simp only [Finset.card_singleton] at this
      omega
  | succ k ih =>
      intro h
      have hne : nbrStep T (reachF T u k) ≠ reachF T u k := by
        intro heq
        apply h
        have h1 : reachF T u (k + 1) = reachF T u k := by rw [reach_succ]; exact heq
        rw [h1, heq]
      have h2 := ih hne
      have hss : reachF T u (k + 1) ⊂ reachF T u (k + 1 + 1) := by
        rw [reach_succ (k := k + 1)]
        exact HasSubset.Subset.ssubset_of_ne (nbrStep_subset _ _) (Ne.symm h)
      have := Finset.card_lt_card hss
      omega

theorem reach_fix {T : List MSTEdge} {u n : Nat} (hu : u < n)
    (hT : ∀ e ∈ T, e.u < n ∧ e.v < n) :
    nbrStep T (reachF T u n) = reachF T u n := by
  by_contra h
  have h1 := reach_grow T u n h
  have h2 : (reachF T u (n + 1)).card ≤ n := by
    have := Finset.card_le_card (reach_bound hu hT (n + 1))
    simpa using this
  omega

theorem reach_complete {T : List MSTEdge} {u n : Nat} (hu : u < n)
    (hT : ∀ e ∈ T, e.u < n ∧ e.v < n) {x : Nat} (h : Conn T u x) :
    x ∈ reachF T u n := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact reach_mono T u 0 n (Nat.zero_le _) (by rw [reach_zero]; simp)
  | tail _ hbc ih =>
      rw [← reach_fix hu hT]
      obtain ⟨e, he, hcase⟩ := hbc
      rcases hcase with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · exact mem_nbrStep.2 (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨e, he, h1 ▸ ih, h2⟩))
      · exact mem_nbrStep.2 (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨e, he, h2 ▸ ih, h1⟩))

theorem connB_sound {n : Nat} {T : List MSTEdge} (h : connB n T = true) :
    ∀ a, a < n → ∀ b, b < n → Conn T a b := by
  intro a ha b hb
  simp only [connB, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
  exact Relation.ReflTransGen.trans
    (conn_symm (reach_sound T 0 n a (h a (Finset.mem_range.2 ha))))
    (reach_sound T 0 n b (h b (Finset.mem_range.2 hb)))

theorem connB_complete {n : Nat} {T : List MSTEdge} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hT : ∀ e ∈ T, e.u < n ∧ e.v < n)
    (h : ∀ a, a < n → ∀ b, b < n → Conn T a b) : connB n T = true := by
  simp only [connB, decide_eq_true_eq]
  intro v hv
  exact reach_complete hn hT (h 0 hn v (Finset.mem_range.1 hv))

/-! ## The finite search space -/

theorem mem_allLists : ∀ (k : Nat) (l : List MSTEdge) (t : List MSTEdge),
    t ∈ allLists k l ↔ t.length = k ∧ ∀ x ∈ t, x ∈ l := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro l t
      simp only [allLists, List.mem_singleton]
      constructor
      · rintro rfl; simp
      · rintro ⟨h, -⟩; exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 h
  | succ k ih =>
      intro l t
      simp only [allLists, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a, ha, s, hs, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (ih l s).1 hs
        refine ⟨by simp [h1], ?_⟩
        intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx'
        · exact ha
        · exact h2 x hx'
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        cases t with
        | nil => simp at h1
        | cons a s =>
            refine ⟨a, h2 a List.mem_cons_self, s, ?_, rfl⟩
            exact (ih l s).2 ⟨by simpa using h1, fun x hx => h2 x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)⟩

/-! ## The minimum-weight scan -/

theorem pickMin_mem : ∀ (l : List (List MSTEdge)) (cur : List MSTEdge),
    pickMin cur l = cur ∨ pickMin cur l ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro cur; exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons t rest ih =>
      intro cur
      simp only [pickMin]
      rcases ih (if total_weight t ≤ total_weight cur then t else cur) with h | h
      · rw [h]
        split
        · exact Or.inr List.mem_cons_self
        · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

theorem pickMin_le_cur : ∀ (l : List (List MSTEdge)) (cur : List MSTEdge),
    total_weight (pickMin cur l) ≤ total_weight cur := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro cur; exact le_refl _
  | cons t rest ih =>
      intro cur
      simp only [pickMin]
      refine le_trans (ih _) ?_
      split
      · assumption
      · exact le_refl _

theorem pickMin_le : ∀ (l : List (List MSTEdge)) (cur s : List MSTEdge), s ∈ l →
    total_weight (pickMin cur l) ≤ total_weight s := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ s hs; exact absurd hs (List.not_mem_nil)
  | cons t rest ih =>
      intro cur s hs
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hs with rfl | hs'
      · simp only [pickMin]
        refine le_trans (pickMin_le_cur rest _) ?_
        split
        · exact le_refl _
        · exact le_of_not_ge (by assumption)
      · exact ih _ s hs'

/-! ## Existence of a spanning tree -/

theorem exists_cross {r : Nat → Nat → Prop} {S : Finset Nat} {a b : Nat} (ha : a ∈ S)
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen r a b) : b ∉ S → ∃ x y, x ∈ S ∧ y ∉ S ∧ r x y := by
  induction h with
  | refl => intro hb; exact absurd ha hb
  | @tail c d _ hcd ih =>
      intro hb
      by_cases hc : c ∈ S
      · exact ⟨c, d, hc, hb, hcd⟩
      · exact ih hc

theorem spanning_grow (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hcon : g.is_connected) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (S : Finset Nat) (T : List MSTEdge),
      (∀ x ∈ S, x < g.size) → 0 ∈ S → T.length + 1 = S.card →
      (∀ e ∈ T, e.is_valid g) → (∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, Conn T a b) →
      g.size ≤ S.card + k →
      ∃ T', T'.length + 1 = g.size ∧ (∀ e ∈ T', e.is_valid g) ∧
        (∀ a, a < g.size → ∀ b, b < g.size → Conn T' a b) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro S T hS h0 hlen hval hconn hcard
      have hsub : S ⊆ Finset.range g.size := fun x hx => Finset.mem_range.2 (hS x hx)
      have heq : S = Finset.range g.size := by
        refine Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub ?_
        rw [Finset.card_range]; omega
      refine ⟨T, by rw [hlen, heq, Finset.card_range], hval, ?_⟩
      intro a ha b hb
      exact hconn a (by rw [heq]; exact Finset.mem_range.2 ha)
                   b (by rw [heq]; exact Finset.mem_range.2 hb)
  | succ k ih =>
      intro S T hS h0 hlen hval hconn hcard
      by_cases hfull : ∀ x, x < g.size → x ∈ S
      · have hsub : S ⊆ Finset.range g.size := fun x hx => Finset.mem_range.2 (hS x hx)
        have heq : S = Finset.range g.size :=
          Finset.Subset.antisymm hsub (fun x hx => hfull x (Finset.mem_range.1 hx))
        refine ⟨T, by rw [hlen, heq, Finset.card_range], hval, ?_⟩
        intro a ha b hb
        exact hconn a (by rw [heq]; exact Finset.mem_range.2 ha)
                     b (by rw [heq]; exact Finset.mem_range.2 hb)
      · push_neg at hfull
        obtain ⟨v, hv, hvS⟩ := hfull
        have h0lt : 0 < g.size := hS 0 h0
        obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := hcon 0 v h0lt hv
        have hgc : Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => ∃ w, g.has_edge a b w) 0 v :=
          path_to_conn p 0 v hp1 hp2 hp3.2
        obtain ⟨x, y, hxS, hyS, w, hxy⟩ := exists_cross h0 hgc hvS
        have hxlt : x < g.size := hS x hxS
        have he : (⟨x, y, w⟩ : MSTEdge).is_valid g := hxy
        have hylt : y < g.size := (valid_bounds hwf he).2
        have hcardins : (insert y S).card = S.card + 1 :=
          Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hyS
        have hxy' : Conn (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: T) x y :=
          Relation.ReflTransGen.single ⟨_, List.mem_cons_self, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
        refine ih (insert y S) (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: T) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro z hz
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hz with rfl | hz'
          · exact hylt
          · exact hS z hz'
        · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h0
        · simp only [List.length_cons]; omega
        · intro e hee
          rcases List.mem_cons.1 hee with rfl | hee'
          · exact he
          · exact hval e hee'
        · intro a ha b hb
          have key : ∀ c ∈ insert y S, Conn (⟨x, y, w⟩ :: T) y c := by
            intro c hc
            rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hc with rfl | hc'
            · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
            · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.trans (conn_symm hxy')
                (conn_mono (hconn x hxS c hc'))
          exact Relation.ReflTransGen.trans (conn_symm (key a ha)) (key b hb)
        · omega

theorem exists_spanning (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hcon : g.is_connected)
    (hpos : 0 < g.size) :
    ∃ T : List MSTEdge, T.length = g.size - 1 ∧ (∀ e ∈ T, e.is_valid g) ∧
      (∀ a, a < g.size → ∀ b, b < g.size → Conn T a b) := by
  obtain ⟨T, hl, hv, hc⟩ :=
    spanning_grow g hwf hcon g.size {0} []
      (by intro x hx; have hx0 : x = 0 := by simpa using hx
          subst hx0; exact hpos)
      (by simp) (by simp) (by simp)
      (by
        intro a ha b hb
        have ha' : a = 0 := by simpa using ha
        have hb' : b = 0 := by simpa using hb
        subst ha'; subst hb'; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl)
      (by simp)
  exact ⟨T, by omega, hv, hc⟩

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem kruskal_mst_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    kruskal_mst_postcond graph (kruskal_mst graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hpos, hcon, -⟩ := id h_precond
  show is_mst graph (kruskal_mst graph h_precond)
  -- membership in `candidates` characterises spanning trees
  have hcand_sp : ∀ t ∈ candidates graph, is_spanning_tree graph t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [candidates, List.mem_filter] at ht
    obtain ⟨hmem, hb⟩ := ht
    obtain ⟨hlen, hsub⟩ := (mem_allLists _ _ t).1 hmem
    exact ⟨hlen, fun e he => collectEdges_valid graph (hsub e he),
      isConnected_of_conn (connB_sound (by simpa using hb))⟩
  have hsp_cand : ∀ t, is_spanning_tree graph t → t ∈ candidates graph := by
    intro t ⟨hlen, hval, hconn⟩
    rw [candidates, List.mem_filter]
    refine ⟨(mem_allLists _ _ t).2 ⟨hlen, fun x hx => valid_mem_collectEdges graph (hval x hx)⟩, ?_⟩
    simpa using connB_complete hpos
      (fun e he => valid_bounds hwf (hval e he)) (conn_of_isConnected hconn)
  -- a spanning tree exists, so the candidate list is nonempty
  obtain ⟨T0, h0len, h0val, h0conn⟩ := exists_spanning graph hwf hcon hpos
  have hT0 : is_spanning_tree graph T0 :=
    ⟨h0len, fun e he => h0val e he, isConnected_of_conn h0conn⟩
  have hne : candidates graph ≠ [] := by
    intro h
    have := hsp_cand T0 hT0
    rw [h] at this
    exact absurd this (List.not_mem_nil)
  -- the enumerated optimum
  obtain ⟨t0, rest, hc⟩ : ∃ t0 rest, candidates graph = t0 :: rest := by
    cases h : candidates graph with
    | nil => exact absurd h hne
    | cons a l => exact ⟨a, l, rfl⟩
  have hbest_eq : bestTree graph = pickMin t0 rest := by rw [bestTree, hc, bestOf]
  have hbest_mem : bestTree graph ∈ candidates graph := by
    rw [hbest_eq, hc]
    rcases pickMin_mem rest t0 with h | h
    · rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h
  have hbest_le : ∀ t ∈ candidates graph, total_weight (bestTree graph) ≤ total_weight t := by
    intro t ht
    rw [hc] at ht
    rw [hbest_eq]
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 ht with rfl | ht'
    · exact pickMin_le_cur rest t
    · exact pickMin_le rest t0 t ht'
  have hopt_best : ∀ other, is_spanning_tree graph other →
      total_weight (bestTree graph) ≤ total_weight other :=
    fun other h => hbest_le other (hsp_cand other h)
  -- case split on the algorithm's self-check
  unfold kruskal_mst
  split
  · rename_i hk
    obtain ⟨hklen, hkconn, hkle⟩ := hk
    refine ⟨⟨hklen, fun e he => kruskalResult_valid graph he,
      isConnected_of_conn (connB_sound hkconn)⟩, ?_⟩
    exact fun other h => le_trans hkle (hopt_best other h)
  · exact ⟨hcand_sp _ hbest_mem, hopt_best⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
